new_suite.default: GREEN_ONLY; any failure/error/skip exits nonzero; no --expect-red bypass

obligations.D01: real signed DEB and unique regular member pass; unrelated symlink allowed
obligations.D03: control Package/Version/Architecture matches signed Packages record
obligations.D06: selected member duplicate after leading-dot normalization rejected
obligations.D07: tampered Release rejected by actual donor before archive tool invocation
obligations.I01: fixture signing reused with actual consumer donor ArchivePolicy identity; wrong module identity remains rejected
obligations.E01: absolute/traversal/empty/dot/backslash member paths rejected; repeated leading ./ accepted
obligations.E02: missing members, empty/noncanonical/duplicate/unknown-archive requests and bad hashes rejected
obligations.E04: actual installed dpkg-deb none/gzip/xz/zstd reads; unsupported compression rejected
obligations.R03: real subprocess stderr and timeout bounds

implementation_choice: Reuse actual verify_chain then dpkg-deb --ctrl-tarfile/--fsys-tarfile; stdlib tar reader; no DEB parser, install, maintainer script, extractall, compiler or ldd
path_policy: Strip repeated leading ./ only; allow root directory .; reject absolute, empty/internal dot/dotdot segments, backslashes and control bytes; required paths already normalized; selected members must be unique regular files; unrelated ordinary symlinks are not resolved or globally rejected
review: One sequential PHYS-MATH provenance/claim review, then one PHYS-MATH-CODE review; one bounded P0/P1 repair at most; same assistant, not an independent reviewer
publication: One writer and publisher; new REI branch non-force push, Draft PR, append-only BASS-18 comment after actual final result; optional page footer only if needed
